system.summary: PV 4; cutting weapons below excellent quality risk losing 1d10 (OR 8-10) BV on a 1 on a d10.
system.description: The petrified outer skin of the giant gives it an almost impenetrable defense (Protection value 4). Edge weapons with a quality lower than excellent run the risk of breaking when they strike the surface of the giant. Each time such a weapon successfuly hits the giant, the game master makes a luck roll with 1d10. If the outcome of the roll is 1, the edge weapon takes 1d10 (OR 8-10) points of damage and lowers its Breach Value by the same amount.
